target: Reservoir Protocol rUSD local PSM mint/redeem arbitrage on BSC
reason: No documented local PSM entry. Reservoir's official contract-address page says all core contracts, including the USDC/USDT/USD1 PSMs, are on Ethereum; its BNB table lists only rUSD and wsrUSD. At BSC head 134613592 the listed rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34 has code and answers name() as Reservoir Stablecoin and totalSupply(), but its bytecode dispatch lacks the PSM redeem(uint256) selector 0xdb006a75. An eth_call from fresh 0x1111...1111 with cast-encoded redeem(1000000) reverted 0x, reproduced with the same calldata. The address 0x4809010926aec940b550D34a46A52739f996D75D is the Ethereum USDC PSM but the official BNB table names it wsrUSD, and its BSC name() answers Wrapped Savings rUSD. A local BSC DEX->PSM->DEX atomic route therefore has no verified PSM to call. No bot built. Do not confuse a same-name token 0xa9015634...8e2a3 (BscScan 3 holders, 0 transfers) with the official rUSD.
numbers: BSC head 134613592 (rpc.py eth_blockNumber 2026-11-20); official address list https://docs.reservoir.xyz/security-and-compliance/smart-contract-addresses.md; primary PSM source https://github.com/reservoir-protocol/reservoir/blob/master/src/PegStabilityModule.sol; relay reads saved scratch/reservoir-rusd-bsc-official-code.json, scratch/reservoir-wsrusd-bsc-official-code.json, scratch/reservoir-rusd-bsc-redeem.json, scratch/reservoir-rusd-bsc-redeem-repeat.json.
